safe.batteryBody: Do not crush or burn cells.
safe.crtBody: Glass and panels need a covered handover.
safe.ppeBody: Gloves and closed shoes for sharp edges.

faq.q1: Does the public page show my phone number?
faq.a1: No. Verification shows lot status only.
faq.q2: Can I create a lot offline?
faq.a2: Yes. It stays on the phone and syncs when the network returns.
faq.a3: Demo login is enabled in development and can be reset by an admin.
